## Checklist

- [ ] One folder `avatars/<id>/`, flat files, with a `manifest.json`
- [ ] `license` set (SPDX), and the artwork is mine or I may redistribute it under it
- [ ] Made with the help of an AI tool? Say which one here:
- [ ] `npm run avatar -- validate` passes (from a claude-pet clone next to this one)
- [ ] Tried on my own creature (dragged the `.claudepet` onto it)
- [ ] For an update: `version` bumped
